confidence_notes: Manufacturer-derived five-speed specification agrees with five accepted direct gears and the visible dogleg gate. Standing-start clutch, lift/rev-match upshifts, manual-blip/rev-match downshifts, lack of automatic cut/blip, and round no-display rim were directly tested. The downshift blip was approved as required from that drive, and was revised to optional once the gearbox was established as all-synchromesh: a synchromesh does not need a blip for the gear to engage. What the simulator demands is carried as a sourced override rather than changing the real-car value. Historical running-shift clutch use remains unknown.
scope_notes: The five-versus-six-speed source conflict is resolved for the exact AMS2 representation only. The gearbox construction rests on one marque-specialist secondary source and is approved at medium; the car was never homologated as a vehicle, so no primary route to the field exists.
